title: Temporal Multi-Omics Analysis of Mouse Bone Marrow Responses to Radiation Exposure
summary: Random-Forest models and SHAP analysis integrated transcriptomic, proteomic and metabolomic measurements to identify time-specific mouse bone-marrow responses to radiation. The study reported an early immune response, intermediate metabolic reprogramming and later cell-cycle disruption, with candidate markers including Sapcd2, CDK1, FRIL1 and taurine. These are study-specific biomarker findings.
